name: holy-grail-layout
title: Holy Grail Layout
description: Classic five-region web shell with header, persistent navigation sidebar, main content, contextual aside, and footer.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Swiss
Macrostructure: Split
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Responsive Five Box Shell: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
